plainTranslation: Their presence and the way they carry themselves work smoothly with your need for freedom and openness to change.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
summaryShort: Their presence and the way they carry themselves work smoothly with your need for freedom and openness to change.
summaryDeep: Their presence and the way they carry themselves work smoothly with your need for freedom and openness to change. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
